methods.note: The TRIC description is supported on pp. 2-7: a pDTM solved by finite volumes, a projection-based CTM (Algorithms 1-3), and a FloTHERM v12.2 benchmark with under 3% discrepancy. The 15-20x CPU claim is on pp. 10 and 13. 'No optimizer or controller' and 'static' are consistent with Section 4.4. However, p. 12 does not state the JEDEC ambient or boundary conditions for the multi-source case, and the FloTHERM maps are not shown. Methods are not enough to make the scenario reproducible.

code.note: All 16 pages and the empty assets list show no code, repository, availability statement or input files. Only the DOI and the CC BY license appear. TRIC itself is described as a proprietary graphical tool. Nothing can be verified or executed.

parameters.note: Package size, epad, die, HS size and 0.5 W per HS are verified as text on p. 12. The Table 1 Layout #2 row is garbled in the pdftotext output. The extraction asserts dT4=56.31 and dTcenter=54.13 for layout #2, but the tokens in that garbled row suggest dT4≈54.13 and dTcenter≈57.06. Those cells were not resolved against a rendered table. HS positions, die position, thicknesses, material conductivities, board properties and heat-transfer coefficients are missing. The 375 um die thickness and 0.9 mm package thickness are generic Section 4 or eQFP statements, not stated for this case.

config.note: The extraction's experiment has an empty floorplan and empty power_w, so no block has x_m, y_m, width_m, height_m or same-scenario power. Figure 13 is only a sketch that was never visually verified or digitized. Ambient temperature, boundary conditions and board model are not given for this scenario. The extraction sets kind=custom_2d_steady while also setting steady_2d_relevant=false and listing essential 3D mismatches, which is internally inconsistent.

data.note: Table 1 and Figure 13 are only checked via pdftotext, with no rendered page image or asset. The layout #1 row (56.31 x4, 57.06, 57.06) and the layout #3 and #4 rows read consistently. The layout #2 row is interleaved and ambiguous, and the extraction's cell assignment conflicts with a plausible reading. The dTmax values of 59.58, 55.15 and 56.35 are only plausible, not confirmed. Layout #1 dTmax=57.06 is internally consistent with the paper text that dTcenter=dTmax in layout #1, but it was not confirmed visually. The FloTHERM comparison data for this case is absent.

findings.reason: The pdftotext output is garbled and interleaved with layout #1 values. The extraction's assignment (dT4=56.31, dTcenter=54.13) is unsupported and likely wrong; the tokens suggest dT4≈54.13 and dTcenter≈57.06. The row was not verified against a rendered image.
Both are empty. No block has coordinates or same-scenario power. Figure 13 positions were not digitized or visually checked. No complete floorplan or power map exists.

The extraction labels the experiment custom_2d_steady but states steady_2d_relevant=false and lists essential 3D mismatches. The scenario is a 3D package-level pDTM with epad, mold, leads, board and JEDEC convection BCs. Calling it a 2D reproduction would be unsupported.

Neither the ambient temperature nor the exact JEDEC boundary conditions (heat-transfer coefficients, board) are given for the multi-source eQFN case. Tamb=20 C appears only for the Figure 11 eTQFP cases. The 57.06 K rise cannot be placed in absolute terms or reproduced.
findings.locator: PDF p. 12 Section 4.4; PDF p. 10 Section 4.3

findings.reason: 375 um is stated in the eQFP bullet, and 0.9 mm in the eQFN bullet as 'adopted for the simulations in Section 4'. Neither is confirmed for the multi-source eQFN case, so they are inferred. The extraction itself flags the die thickness as uncertain.
findings.locator: PDF p. 3 (eQFP bullet); PDF p. 4 (eQFN bullet)

findings.reason: No code, config, geometry or data assets exist (assets list empty). Code and config cannot be verified. A bare DOI is not evidence of availability.
The under-3% agreement for maxima is only asserted in text, and the FloTHERM maps are 'not shown'. It cannot be verified for this case.
The evidence entry is tagged pdf_page 10, but the claims it combines are drawn from pp. 10, 12 and 13. The page attribution is imprecise.
